notes: Two additions from the kitchen. Importing a recipe now collects every photo the site offers (many sites publish several crops or shots) and, when there is more than one, the Cooking page shows them as tappable thumbnails so you pick which becomes the recipe photo - the first is pre-selected, so nothing changes if you don't care. And the kiosk recipe page gains a floating timer button: tap the round stopwatch in the corner, build any duration from +30 sec / +1 / +5 / +10 / +30 min chips, and hit Start. Manual timers use the same countdown pills, bell tones and Alexa announcement as the tap-a-step timers, and odd durations now read naturally on screen and out loud (5 min 30 sec).
